column3: “Jesus answered” supplies the name and answering; hearts pluralizes heart.
“Must be put to death” renders die the death.
“Devoted to God” supplies the gift’s recipient.
The refusal to allow him is rendered passively.
BSB omits this verse with the critical text; it appears in the Textus Receptus (“If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear”).
The latrine is omitted; active purifying all foods becomes the statement that all foods are clean.
“Hearts” pluralizes heart; adultery is moved here from the next verse.
BSB’s “Yes” matches the Textus Receptus (ναὶ); the critical text lacks it. “Dogs” omits the diminutive.
